title: Implement: one balance, two operations

checklist.step: Both operations share one balance; separate accounts stay separate
Every operation draws the balance it left behind

hints: Two functions agree on a value only if they reach the same binding. Ask which frame can hold it for both.
Draw the frame that make_account creates, and the frames of one withdraw call and one deposit call. What is the parent of each, and where does an assignment inside them land by default?

Keep the balance in make_account's frame. Each inner function that rebinds it must say that the name is the enclosing one, not a new local; withdraw decides whether to refuse before it changes anything.
